attchmntText: G-TEC JAINX EDUCATION LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary:
G-TEC JAINX EDUCATION Limited filed newspaper advertisements on 14.11.2026 regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 13.11.2026. Consolidated net profit after tax was a loss of 23.59 lakhs for the quarter ended 30.09.2026, compared to a profit of 29.79 lakhs in the same period last year. Standalone net profit after tax was a loss of 25.42 lakhs for the quarter, versus a profit of 26.30 lakhs previously. For the half year, consolidated net profit after tax was a loss of 6.20 lakhs, compared to a profit of 30.48 lakhs last year. Standalone net profit after tax was a loss of 0.88 lakhs, compared to a profit of 38.66 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter were negative 0.23 rupees on a consolidated basis and negative 0.25 rupees on a standalone basis.

Sundaram Multi Pap Limited also filed results for the same period. The Board approved the results on 13.11.2026. Standalone net profit after tax was a loss of 18.01 lakhs for the quarter ended 30.09.2026, compared to a profit of 83.02 lakhs last year. For the half year, net profit after tax was 13.80 lakhs, compared to 38.63 lakhs previously. Earnings per share for the quarter were zero rupees.

attchmntText: G-TEC JAINX EDUCATION LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: G-TEC JAINX EDUCATION LIMITED announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved and took on record the Standalone and Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The meeting commenced at 03:00 P.M. and concluded at 5:40 P.M. Independent Auditors N K Mittal & Associates reviewed the financial statements. The auditors confirmed that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the Standalone or Consolidated results. The consolidated results include the parent company and two wholly owned subsidiaries, Keerti Institute India Private Limited and G-Tec Jain Keerti Career Education Private Limited. The financial results were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard 34. Copies of the financial statements are enclosed with the announcement for regulatory record.

attchmntText: G-TEC JAINX EDUCATION LIMITED has informed regarding DOutcomeofMeetingofCommitteeofIndependentDirectorsforOpenOfferofGTecIainEducationLimited
voiceSummary: G-Tec Jainx Education Limited announced the outcome of its Committee of Independent Directors meeting held on 13th November 2026. The committee reviewed the open offer by G-Tec Education Private Limited and Mr. Roychand Chenrai to acquire up to 26,491,166 equity shares representing 26.00% of the share capital. The offer price is Rs. 29 per share. The committee concluded that the open offer is fair and reasonable. The announcement references the public announcement dated 28th September 2026 and the letter of offer dated 04th November 2026. Archana Saini, with DIN 08427866, served as the Chairperson of the Committee of Independent Directors.

attchmntText: G-TEC JAINX EDUCATION LIMITED has submitted a copy of the Letter of Offer from pursuant to Regulations 3(1) and 3(3) read with applicable provisions of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
